statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one VMware vCenter Server entry, listed under vendorProject VMware or Broadcom, with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if a KEV entry naming VMware vCenter Server in its product field carries a dateAdded between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming VMware vCenter Server carries a dateAdded inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The FRED series DGS10 records a daily value at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if any non-missing DGS10 observation dated inside the window is 5.00 or greater as published in the FRED series.
failure_condition: Every non-missing DGS10 observation inside the window prints below 5.00 percent.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A NATO member state formally requests Article 4 consultations between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if NATO publishes a statement confirming Article 4 consultations were invoked, and Reuters and the Associated Press both report the request, dated inside the window.
failure_condition: No member state requests Article 4 consultations inside the window.
